name: Megurikuru Natsu no Hi wa...
source:
The protagonist is a student at a certain academy.
Having the summer vacation scheduled soon, he made up 
his mind to confess his love to his classmate Shimatani Tomoka.
His confession succeeded. 

He wanted to fully enjoy his last summer vacation in the academy with her,
but she is as serious as saying she has to spend the vacation studying for entrance exams.
So they study together in his house thanks to his parents often absent from home.
As they study in a locked room, they gradually get closer to each other.
After thinking for a long time, he tries to even deepen the relationship, but......

The situation shows signs of change since the day.
Suddenly she takes distance from him.
Childhood friend's uncomfortable response to his asking.
A man's shadow he can barely recognize behind the scene.

He ponders every time the summer day comes:
"If I made a different choice in that time, my life should be better....."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229050.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是某所学院的学生。暑假即将到来，他下定决心向同班同学岛谷知香告白。告白成功了。

他想和知香尽情享受在学院的最后一个暑假，但她非常认真地说必须把假期用于准备升学考试。由于父母经常不在家，两人便在他的房间一起学习。在锁上的房间里学习时，他们逐渐靠近彼此。思考许久后，他甚至试图进一步加深关系，但是……

从那天起，情况出现了变化。
她突然与他保持距离。
青梅竹马面对询问时给出令人不安的回应。
背后出现了一个几乎无法辨认的男人身影。

每当夏日到来，他就会思考：
“如果当时作出不同选择，我的人生应该会更好……”

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE229050.html]DLsite English[/url]）
